reason: The README clearly describes an MCP bridge whose primary purpose is to connect local or remote MCP servers to DeepSeek Harness and expose their tools for agent orchestration.

summaries.zh: 将本地或远程 MCP 服务器连接到 DeepSeek Harness，并自动把其工具注册为智能体可调用的工具。
summaries.en: Connects local or remote MCP servers to DeepSeek Harness and automatically registers their tools for agent use.

capabilities: spawns and manages configured local child processes
connects to remote MCP servers over HTTP/SSE
registers and forwards MCP tools to the DSH agent
passes configured environment variables to MCP servers
enables connected tools to access external services, files, databases, or other resources according to their permissions
